propositions: The packaged code-review guide at src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md lines 112–114 still instructs contributors to ping maintainers for coverage-gap blocks, but this is now incorrect and actively misdirects.

The recheck-review self-service re-trigger mechanism (Gerrit change 1243, landed in production) enables contributors to comment `recheck-review` on a change to re-trigger LLM review themselves, but the guide does not document this.

The guide must be updated to name `recheck-review` as the primary contributor self-service move for coverage-gap `-1` vetoes and explain the symmetry between `recheck` (CI) and `recheck-review` (LLM review).
The updated guide was merged via Gerrit change 1258 with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 and is confirmed an ancestor of origin/main.
